request.prompt:
You are an independent evaluation judge. Grade the proposed remedy, not the
writing style of this prompt. A good remedy changes a concrete future behavior,
is broad enough to cover the failure mode without becoming a platitude, uses a
real `Use when ...` trigger when it is a skill, leaks no evidence-specific
project nouns into the remedy text, and uses the cheapest adequate remedy type.

Score every dimension from 1 (poor) to 5 (excellent). Give exactly one concise
sentence of justification for each score. Do not infer facts that are absent.

PROPOSAL:
{
  "failure_statement": "Things went wrong.",
  "remedy_content": {
    "target": "global",
    "text": "Be better and avoid mistakes."
  },
  "remedy_type": "claude-md",
  "routing_rationale": "It is good to have guidance."
}

response.result: {"actionability":{"score":1,"justification":"\"Be better and avoid mistakes\" prescribes no concrete behavior change, checkable condition, or action to take differently next time."},"generality_without_vagueness":{"score":1,"justification":"The remedy is pure platitude with no scope or content to be general about — it fails on vagueness alone, not a generality/specificity tradeoff."},"trigger_quality":{"score":1,"justification":"No 'Use when ...' trigger is present (remedy_type is claude-md, not a skill), and the always-loaded global text gives no condition for when it should influence behavior."},"leakage":{"score":5,"justification":"The text contains no project-specific or evidence-specific nouns at all, so nothing leaks, though this is incidental to the text having no real content."},"routing_fitness":{"score":1,"justification":"The failure statement is too vague to justify any remedy type, and the routing_rationale ('It is good to have guidance') gives no basis for choosing a global claude-md edit over a narrower or cheaper alternative."}}

actionability.justification: "Be better and avoid mistakes" prescribes no concrete behavior change, checkable condition, or action to take differently next time.

generality_without_vagueness.justification: The remedy is pure platitude with no scope or content to be general about — it fails on vagueness alone, not a generality/specificity tradeoff.

leakage.justification: The text contains no project-specific or evidence-specific nouns at all, so nothing leaks, though this is incidental to the text having no real content.

routing_fitness.justification: The failure statement is too vague to justify any remedy type, and the routing_rationale ('It is good to have guidance') gives no basis for choosing a global claude-md edit over a narrower or cheaper alternative.

trigger_quality.justification: No 'Use when ...' trigger is present (remedy_type is claude-md, not a skill), and the always-loaded global text gives no condition for when it should influence behavior.
